business_problem: NDS Cognitive Labs needed to help Clip support a fast-growing base of first-time digital-finance users at scale, answering questions about fees, setup, payments, and credit without relying on expensive manual support or traditional banking infrastructure.
solution_summary: NDS Cognitive Labs used IBM watsonx natural-language capabilities, NeuralSeek, and IBM Cloud to build a retrieval-augmented virtual assistant tailored to Clip’s fintech support model. The system identifies customer intent, retrieves real-time information from external sources, and generates context-rich responses about remote payments, credit lines, fees, and onboarding rather than serving static FAQ content. Salesforce Cloud integration lets the assistant validate identities, generate leads, and open level-2 support cases when conversations need escalation, while omnichannel delivery extends the experience across websites, social media, WhatsApp, and other digital touchpoints. By combining NLP, RAG, CRM data, and real-time retrieval, NDS created a service layer that advances financial inclusion for underserved businesses and individuals while also improving operational efficiency for the fintech. The result is a scalable conversational platform that handles high concurrency and leaves human agents free to focus on harder cases.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx
solution_components.role: Provides the natural language and generative AI capabilities behind the virtual assistant.

solution_components.name: NeuralSeek
solution_components.role: Augments the assistant with retrieval-augmented generation so it can ground responses in current information.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the conversational AI platform that supports high concurrency and omnichannel delivery.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides CRM data and workflow hooks for lead generation, case creation, and identity validation.

data_flow: Customer questions arrive through web, social, WhatsApp, and other digital channels, watsonx and NeuralSeek interpret the request and retrieve relevant real-time information, Salesforce Cloud contributes CRM context for validation or escalation, and the assistant returns a direct answer or opens a higher-tier support case.
business_outcome: The NDS-built assistant improved customer support efficiency for Clip, resolved most inquiries autonomously, shortened interaction times dramatically, and increased digital-service adoption among users who are often new to financial technology.
metrics: More than 6,000 simultaneous interactions handled by the virtual assistant
